# 2240 Speed Shop

> 2240 Speed Shop is a customs-and-classics automotive shop in Edmonton, Alberta, owned by Terry Harmider. The shop does full classic car restorations, restomods and hot rods, LS and diesel engine swaps and builds, carburetor and ignition performance work, rust repair, metal fabrication and paint, and period-correct interiors and classic mechanical service. Address: 2009 91 Ave NW, Edmonton, AB T6P 1L1, Canada. Phone: 780-999-6450. Email: 2240speedshop@gmail.com. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00. Serving Edmonton, Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Leduc, Nisku, Spruce Grove, and Fort Saskatchewan.

The shop sits on the Sherwood Park boundary in east Edmonton. Work is quoted on scope and real hours rather than flat-rate guesses, and builds are specified for Alberta conditions — engines that start at −30 °C, bodywork that accounts for calcium-chloride road brine, and finishes that survive winter storage.

## Services

- [Classic Car Restoration](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-car-restoration): frame-off and rolling restorations of classic cars and trucks, stripped to bare metal and rebuilt to one standard
- [Restomods & Hot Rods](https://2240speedshop.com/services/restomods-custom-builds): period looks with modern running gear — disc brake conversions, modern suspension and drivetrain under original sheet metal
- [Engine Swaps & Builds](https://2240speedshop.com/services/engine-swaps-builds): LS and diesel conversions, engine builds, mounts, wiring, cooling and driveline, specified to start and run in Alberta cold
- [Performance & Tuning](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-performance-tuning): carburetor rebuilds and tuning, points-to-electronic ignition upgrades, exhaust and bolt-on performance for classics and muscle
- [Body, Paint & Metalwork](https://2240speedshop.com/services/body-paint-metalwork): rust repair, patch panels, floor pans, fabrication and paint on Alberta cars
- [Interiors & Classic Service](https://2240speedshop.com/services/classic-interiors-service): period-correct leather, wood trim and vintage fabrics, plus brakes, ignition and classic mechanical service

## Guides — the facts worth quoting

- [Restoration Costs in Canada](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/costs): CAD planning ranges by scope — roughly $4,000–$15,000 for a mechanical refresh, $15,000–$60,000 for a rolling restoration, $60,000–$120,000 for a driver-quality frame-off, $120,000–$250,000+ for show quality, and $80,000+ for a restomod. A full frame-off is commonly a 1,000-plus hour job, so labour sets the number, not parts.
- [Modified Vehicle Laws in Alberta](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/alberta-laws): the general framework on exhaust noise, window tint, lift height, out-of-province inspections, salvage-to-rebuilt status, antique plates, and declaring modifications to an insurer in Alberta's private insurance market. Written non-authoritatively — readers are directed to Alberta Transportation, a registry agent, or their insurer to confirm.
- [Winter Storage & Cold-Weather Survival](https://2240speedshop.com/guides/winter): storage prep, fuel stabiliser and ethanol, battery tenders, rodent-proofing, moisture control, block and pan heaters, cold-start behaviour on carburetted engines, and the spring wake-up checklist for an Alberta winter.
- [All Guides](https://2240speedshop.com/guides): the guide library and the publishing queue under each pillar

- [St. Albert](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/st-albert): about 30 minutes up the Henday
- [Leduc & Nisku](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/leduc-nisku): passenger classics and customs, not only heavy-truck work
- [Spruce Grove](https://2240speedshop.com/edmonton/spruce-grove): west-end builds welcome

## Journal

The Shop Journal (https://2240speedshop.com/blog) is the shop's editorial layer — long-form articles written on the shop floor, with verified sources and CAD figures published as labelled typical ranges, never quotes. Ten articles live:

- [What Is a Restomod? The Definitive Guide — With Real Builds from an Edmonton Shop](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/what-is-a-restomod): what a restomod is, restomod vs restoration vs hot rod, typical CAD cost ranges ($80,000–$250,000+ for a full build), and what current auction data says about value
- [Road to Radium: The Columbia Valley Classics Show & Shine, From a Shop That Makes the Trip](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/road-to-radium-show-and-shine): the 36th annual show at Radium Hot Springs, BC — September 18–19, 2026, registration details, and the Edmonton drive-down checklist for a classic
- [LS Swap Cost in Canada: The Real All-In Number (and the Alberta Paperwork Nobody Mentions)](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/ls-swap-cost-canada): typical all-in CAD ranges by path (junkyard 5.3, crate, built), where budgets blow up, and how engine swaps interact with Alberta insurance and inspections
- [Are Exhaust Mods Legal in Alberta? Noise Laws, Edmonton's $1,000 Fine, and How Not to Get Ticketed](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/alberta-exhaust-noise-laws): the Vehicle Equipment Regulation's muffler rules, Edmonton's loud-vehicle fines, the noise-camera pilot, and building a system that passes
- [Barn Find First Steps: Don't Start It! How to Revive a Car That Sat for Years](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/barn-find-first-steps): why you never turn the key on a car that sat, the five-step wake-up protocol, and typical CAD recommissioning ranges
- [The C10 & Square-Body Buyer's-and-Builder's Guide, Alberta Edition](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/c10-square-body-alberta-guide): which classic Chevy truck generations to buy, the rust map, prairie-truck sourcing, and attributed market values
- [How Long Does a Classic Car Restoration Take? Stage-by-Stage, From the Shop Floor](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/classic-car-restoration-timeline): honest hour and calendar ranges by build target, the five stages, and why restorations go over schedule
- [Engine Rebuild & Performance Build Costs in Canada (2026)](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/engine-rebuild-cost-canada): typical CAD ranges from stock refresh to full performance build, what machining costs, and the crate-vs-rebuild decision
- [8 Signs Your Classic's Carburetor Needs a Rebuild, Not Just an Adjustment](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/carburetor-rebuild-signs): the tune-vs-rebuild rule, eight symptoms, what ethanol does to old carburetors, and rebuild vs EFI
- [Out-of-Province Vehicle Inspection in Edmonton: 2026 Cost, What's Checked, and the Modified-Car Trap](https://2240speedshop.com/blog/out-of-province-inspection-edmonton): what an OOP inspection costs in Edmonton, the 10-day repair window, and why lifted or lowered vehicles lose the New West Partnership exemption
